def rule(t, A):
    # skip New York 16:45-17:45, any day: 15 min before the 17:00 rollover + the first trades after the daily break
    import datetime as dt
    ts = t["t_in"]
    y = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, dt.timezone.utc).year
    m3 = dt.datetime(y, 3, 1, tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc); dst0 = m3 + dt.timedelta(days=(6 - m3.weekday()) % 7 + 7)
    n11 = dt.datetime(y, 11, 1, tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc); dst1 = n11 + dt.timedelta(days=(6 - n11.weekday()) % 7)
    off = -4 if dst0.timestamp() + 7 * 3600 <= ts < dst1.timestamp() + 6 * 3600 else -5
    d = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts + off * 3600, dt.timezone.utc)
    m, wd = d.hour * 60 + d.minute + d.second / 60.0, d.weekday()      # New York minute of day, weekday 0=Mon .. 4=Fri .. 6=Sun
    return 16 * 60 + 45 <= m < 17 * 60 + 45
